answer: Every identity carries a jade seal, and the mint stamps one only when a sponsor with no stake in it posts copper behind it, which the glacier destroys if that seal is judged fake. A sponsor stakes behind one seal in its life, so the operator's thousandth identity needs the last unused sponsor at a quote the glacier's burn record has pushed far above the first; past that it must bribe sponsors who already burned one. An honest newcomer finds an untouched sponsor at one copper.
